scientific_integrity: Both independent standalone finite enumerations are reproducible and explicitly distinguish mod-two corroboration from integral homotopy proof. The public motivating source predates this result and is not claimed to contain it.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for the specified twelve-vertex Chvátal graph only; integral homotopy and deletion/link profiles are certified by exhaustive acyclic matchings and elementary collapses; group action is determined only on homology, not as an equivariant sphere model. No complete universal originality guarantee; unindexed literature overlap is possible.
title: The Chvátal two-independence sphere and its reversed deletion–link dichotomy
